message.content: Based on the records provided, Li Hua has already paid her rent for both April and May. Specifically, there are entries indicating that Li Hua transferred the rent through the bank transfer for April (entry 4) and May (entry 10). In both cases, Li Hua confirmed receipt of the rent and expressed gratitude for the timely payment. Therefore, there is no outstanding rent owed by Li Hua to Adam Smith for either April or May.
